outlook.statement: After taking improvement steps as stated above, the Company shall be in a position to strengthen its capabilities as well as address the future opportunities in India and other markets of choice. The above measures undertaken are expected to yield positive results and improve the financial performance of the Company in the coming years.

Phase one of Mega Project nears completion, and phase two targets completion by March 2027. The project is primarily focused on capacity addition of more value-added products to cater to evolving industry needs rather than increasing capacity of existing turnover oriented business products. The financial benefits of the same will begin in late FY 2026-27 and fully reflecting in FY 2027-28.

Targets year-over-year revenue growth of 20% to 25% in FY2026-27 backed by robust market demand across both Steel and Copper sectors; completing ongoing expansions across both divisions; stabilizing production of newly introduced value-added products in Steel division; diversifying and widening product portfolio in Copper division; expanding global footprint by evaluating potential locations for new international offices; optimizing working capital cycle within established credit limits; advancing Mega Project expansion under Maharashtra's PSI scheme with Phase 1 nearing completion and Phase 2 on track for March 2027; financial yields from capex projected to commence late FY2026-27 with full impact in FY2027-28; expanding captive solar capacity from 3 MW to 7 MW (additional 4 MW) to shift ~80% daytime operational power to clean energy; targeting EcoVadis Gold standard; export sales projected to strengthen progressively driven by enhanced product positioning and targeted penetration into high-value international markets.
Planned to install additional solar plant of having a capacity 4 MW to cater the present consumption and the expansion in FY 2026-27
Planned to replace the lightings at rope & copper division also
